notes.title: Minor Optimisation & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Dear players, 

Today we have a small update to implement some minor fixes and optimisations that address stability issues. The update also fixes a rare audio issue which a minority of users are experiencing. 

Time Carnage is also [b]on sale with 50% off[/b] starting today for two weeks! 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WalesInteractive
Twitter: https://twitter.com/WalesInter 

Check out our upcoming horror Maid of Sker https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940

notes.content:

2. Drop & Reload
3. Switch Weapon
4. Repeat

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]

- Challenges should now unlock quicker in Story Mode
- Headshot Challenge should now automatically if you run out of bullets.
- Improved how the physics behave during slow motion
- Fixed an issue where the wrong difficulty is shown when you finish in story mode.
- Fixed an issue with the Back Hole Gun that was causing problems to some models.
- Fixed an issue with the time bomb lasting forever sometimes.

Known Issues:
- Pressing the Steam Menu button on the Vive Controller makes the weapons disappear.
- Accuracy statistic is not updated the first time the statistics show at the end of a level.

notes.title: Time Carnage VR Shooter Out Now With 20% Discount!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xERKyLU.gif[/img]

[H1]LAUNCH DISCOUNT[/H1]

Time Carnage is out now on HTC Vive and Oculus Rift with a 20% launch discount!

Wreak havoc through the ages filled with dinosaurs, monsters, robots, zombies and more in this frantic time-travelling VR wave shooter. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/554280/

[h1]SHOOT, DROP, SWITCH, REPEAT[/h1] 

Time Carnage brings you a fresh take on a VR reload system, unique to your 4-weapon Time Platform. It's a frenzy educing system that's a test to see how ambidextrous you really are!

1. Shoot
2. Drop & Reload
3. Switch Weapon
4. Repeat

[H1]WATCH THE NEW GAMEPLAY TRAILER[/H1]

https://youtu.be/FwZKWj4zFhw

[H1]CAMPAIGN, ARCADE & CHALLENGES[/H1]

Choose your loadout wisely as you’ll manically swap out active guns on the fly in a 16-tier Campaign across the 4th Millennium, the Mesozoic Era, the 6th Millenium, and the 4th Century! That's 4 periods, 16 zones and 160 waves!

The Challenge Mode featuring terrifyingly difficult challenges including Cluster Duck, Love Struck, Event Horizon and loads more to unlock unique perks ranging from Zero-G to Slow Mo to God Mode. Go for Gold! 

Also featuring a Custom Arcade Mode where you can activate any of the perks you've unlocked in any zone, with ANY enemies! Just want to shoot dinosaurs in Zero-G? Or undead dogs with Cupid's Bow in Slow Mo? The customisation is yours to play with!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dY8c8p6.gif[/img]

[h1]REVIEWS[/h1]

Want to find out what the critics are saying? Check out the wave of in-depth reviews —

[url=http://punkandlizard.com/time-carnage-review-psvr/]punkandlizard.com[/url]
[url=http://www.squarexo.co.uk/time-carnage-psvr-review/]squarexo.co.uk[/url]
[url=https://sagamer.co.za/review-time-carnage-psvr]sagamer.co.za[/url]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

•	Immersive first-person VR shooting action with atmospheric 3D sounds
•	Travel through time to hunt in a post-apocalyptic world, prehistoric jungle, icy wasteland and futuristic city
•	A frenzy inducing timed-reload system. Shoot, drop, switch, repeat!
•	Fight against hordes of dinosaurs, monsters, robots and zombies!
•	Unlock and mix-and-match an armoury of over 25 dual-wielding weapons
•	Catch your breath with the time-stalling paradox 
•	Punishing challenges for weapon perks and arcade cheats
•	Play a 16-tier Campaign Mode, Custom Arcade Mode or Challenge Modes including Cluster Duck, Love Struck, Event Horizon!
•	Hidden Bonus Guns! Rubber Ducky, Cupid’s Bow, Black Hole, Golden Gun

notes.content:

[H1]LAUNCH & PRE-ORDER DISCOUNT[/H1]

Fight dinosaurs, monsters, robots, zombies and more in this manic time-travelling VR wave shooter coming April 10th to HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and PSVR! 

Pre-orders are now available with an introductory discount of 20%!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/554280/

[H1]FRENZY INDUCING MODES[/H1]

Choose your loadout wisely as you’ll manically swap out active guns on the fly in a 16-tier Campaign, Custom Arcade Mode or Challenge Mode featuring Cluster Duck, Love Struck and Event Horizon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27202410/26a36f6120d7839409c11eba6a2bcda76c005d8b.jpg[/img]

[h1]ULTIMATE DUAL-WIELDING LOADOUT[/h1] 

Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world, prehistoric jungle, icy wasteland and a futuristic city in search of the ultimate weapon loadout! 

For each zone you’ll handpick a selection of guns to suit your play style and battle with a timed-reload system as you unlock an arsenal of over 25 mix-and-match dual wielding weapons. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27202410/3206da2fe24b3183829a9b692dec8bc86a2d0469.jpg[/img]

[h1]SHOOT, DROP, SWITCH, REPEAT[/h1] 

Finding it too challenging? Keep an eye out for a [b]Time Paradox[/b] — they might just give you an unfair advantage in slow motion!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27202410/262f2938110688d439e7addf5cb5f222a0bc21c2.jpg[/img]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

•	Immersive first-person VR shooting action with atmospheric 3D sounds
•	Travel through time to hunt in a post-apocalyptic world, prehistoric jungle, icy wasteland and futuristic city
•	A frenzy inducing timed-reload system. Shoot, drop, switch, repeat!
•	Fight against hordes of dinosaurs, monsters, robots and zombies!
•	Unlock and mix-and-match an armoury of over 25 dual-wielding weapons
•	Catch your breath with the time-stalling paradox 
•	Punishing challenges for weapon perks and arcade cheats
•	Play a 16-tier Campaign Mode, Custom Arcade Mode or Challenge Modes including Cluster Duck, Love Struck, Event Horizon!
•	Hidden Bonus Guns! Rubber Ducky, Cupid’s Bow, Black Hole, Golden Gun

[h1]JUST FOR FUN[/h1]
